item.title: Ask HN: How do you keep notes organized across long-running side projects?
item.summary: I keep starting side projects that go on for months, and my notes end up scattered between a text file, a couple of markdown docs, and whatever I remembered to write down. Curious how others handle this — do you keep everything in one place, or does it not matter as long as you write it down somewhere?
